name: American Express Centurion Card (Black Card)

loungeAccess.network: Amex Global Lounge Collection (1,550+ lounges worldwide)
otherLounges: American Express Centurion Lounges (unlimited access, unlimited complimentary guests)
Priority Pass Select (unlimited visits, unlimited guests)
Select international first-class and business-class lounges
loungeAccess.notes: The Centurion Card offers the most expansive lounge access of any credit card. Centurion Lounge guests are complimentary (no limit). Priority Pass includes unlimited guests. Specific lounge policies subject to change.

tripDelay.notes: Enhanced trip delay protection. Details may exceed those on the Platinum card.

tripCancellation.notes: Coverage at least equal to the Platinum card. Centurion benefits details are not fully disclosed publicly — estimates based on Amex Platinum baseline.

lostBaggage.notes: Lost/stolen/damaged baggage coverage. High-value items may be capped.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Comprehensive travel accident insurance is expected as part of the Centurion suite. Specific limits not publicly disclosed.

emergencyMedical.notes: Premium Global Assist Hotline with emergency medical evacuation coordination. Centurion members receive dedicated concierge coordination for all emergency services worldwide.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Primary rental car insurance is a common report from Centurion cardholders, though Amex does not publish full details publicly. Decline the rental company's CDW.

airlineCredit.notes: $200 annual airline fee credit (matching Platinum). Additional travel credits may be available to Centurion members at Amex's discretion.

hotelCredit.notes: $200 annual hotel credit for Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection via Amex Travel. Centurion members also receive dedicated FHR concierge with enhanced room upgrades and amenities.

uberCredit.notes: $200 annual Uber Cash credit (at minimum; Centurion may offer additional perks).

otherCredits.name: Initiation Fee
otherCredits.notes: One-time initiation fee of ~$10,000 when first invited to the Centurion program. This is a cost, not a credit.

otherCredits.name: Saks Fifth Avenue Credit
otherCredits.notes: Centurion cardholders reportedly receive up to $1,000 in Saks credits annually (vs. $100 on Platinum). Exact amount may vary by cardholder arrangement.

otherCredits.name: Centurion Concierge
otherCredits.notes: 24/7 dedicated personal concierge for reservations, travel planning, event tickets (including sold-out events), lifestyle management, and more.

rewards.travelRate: 5x on flights booked directly with airlines or through Amex Travel (up to $500,000/year); 5x on prepaid hotels through Amex Travel
rewards.diningRate: 1x (dining bonus not standard; may vary by arrangement)

pointValue.transferPartners: 1:1 transfer to 20+ airline and hotel partners. Centurion members may have access to exclusive transfer bonuses and redemption opportunities.

emergencyContacts.general: Dedicated Centurion Member Services line (by invitation only)
emergencyContacts.international: Worldwide dedicated concierge line (number provided upon invitation)

travelPerks: By invitation only — requires very high annual spend (reported ~$350,000+/year on Amex cards)
Unlimited Centurion Lounge access with unlimited complimentary guests
Unlimited Priority Pass Select visits with unlimited guests
Complimentary top-tier hotel status (Marriott Platinum Elite, Hilton Diamond, etc.)
$200+ annual hotel credit with Fine Hotels + Resorts
Access to exclusive events, pre-sale tickets, reservations at sold-out restaurants
Personalized trip planning through Centurion Travel
Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
bestFor: Ultra-high-net-worth individuals who want the ultimate in prestige, concierge service, and exclusive access — by invitation only
